title: RealisticSleep
description: The plugin accelerates night during sleep while preserving natural world progress
body:
## ✨ Features

* ⏩ **Accelerated night** – instead of instantly skipping the night, time speeds up by a configurable factor.
* 🌱 **Realistic growth** – crops, furnaces, and baby mobs progress during sleep just as they would during a normal night.
* 📈 **Random tick compensation** – automatically scales `RANDOM_TICK_SPEED` to match accelerated time.
* 💤 **All non-guests must sleep** – the plugin counts only *non-guest* players (from `GuestMode`) when deciding if everyone is sleeping.
* 🔄 **Dynamic check every tick** – if a player becomes a guest *while others are already sleeping*, sleep will continue automatically without needing to re-enter the bed.

---

## ⚠️ Limitations

* 🚶‍♂️ **Mob movement is not accelerated** – they will grow faster but won’t move faster.
* 🧪 The plugin is designed specifically for **Folia** and has not been tested on standard Paper/Spigot.

---

This plugin is intended to be used **together with [`GuestMode`](https://modrinth.com/plugin/guestmode)** for correct player counting logic.
